name: language-spinner
description: Learn a language while Claude thinks: the spinner shows a phrase in your target language with its translation

pack.title: Starter pack
pack.description: Built-in phrases. japanese: common verbs conjugated (I'm eating, I want to eat...). none: only your word file

wordFile.title: Word file
wordFile.description: Absolute path to your own JSON file: [{"text": "comer", "gloss": "to eat"}, ...]. Leave empty to use only the starter pack

display.title: Display
display.description: same-line: phrase and translation together. alternate: phrase first, then its translation

intervalSeconds.title: Alternate interval (seconds)
intervalSeconds.description: In alternate display, how long the phrase and then the translation each stay up

rotateSeconds.title: New phrase every (seconds)
rotateSeconds.description: Switch to a new phrase after this many seconds of the same turn. 0 keeps one phrase per turn

separator.title: Separator
separator.description: What goes between phrase and translation in same-line display
